title: Path of souls: the soul's leap to Orion and journey along the Milky Way
place_text: North, Central and South America; worldwide

tellings.quote: Absolutely. It is it is here it in in North America. Uh and and in Central America and in South America. The the path of souls.

plain: The writer Graham Hancock says that peoples across North, Central and South America shared a belief called the path of souls, in which the soul at death leaps to the constellation Orion and then travels along the Milky Way. He tells it from his own research, which he also presented in his television series Ancient Apocalypse, and he raises it because a shared belief across so many places would point to a common ancient source.
